# Thralls
Yautja can abduct humans as thralls: prey who have proven themselves worthy, or interested enough, to be taught to hunt like the Yautja.
## Thrall expectations - Thralls are expected to uphold the Honor Code. - Begging to be thralled is a dishonorable act. - Thralls must be given a thrall bracer box to get their gear. - Thralls are not allowed to use any human ranged weapons. - Roles with a major impact on the round should never be thralled, such as colony physicians, ambassadors, higher-ranking GOVFOR, OPFOR or INSFOR, and specialists.
## Thrall and mentor Thralls are seen as extensions of their mentor, so the mentor is also held responsible should the thrall break the Honor Code. - Yautja are to police their thralls and pick the opponents they hunt. - An unruly or misbehaving thrall can be reprimanded, or executed as a dishonorable foe, at any time by their master. - Thralls should not be force-infected, and if infected should be exterminated.
## Thrall welfare and death - Thralls can be healed by their master, but should not be brought back from the dead. - Each Yautja may only have one thrall per round. - A thrall cannot be saved from death unless it has defeated its opponent. - If a thrall dies, the gear given to it must be recovered.
## Mentor death Should a thrall's master die, the remaining Yautja should retrieve the master's gear and escort the thrall to the starting area of their role: colonists and CLF to the colony, GOVFOR and OPFOR to their ship or FOB. Should there be no Yautja left, the thrall is free to follow their own desires.
